shorts_extract.hook: From 'You Are Here' Place Cells (1971) to crystal-perfect 60° Hexagonal Grid Cells (2005): how O'Keefe and the Mosers found the brain's internal GPS.
shorts_extract.core_experiment: O'Keefe & Dostrovsky (1971 Brain Res.) hippocampal Place Cells + Moser, Rowland & Moser (2005/2015) entorhinal hexagonal Grid Cells (2014 Nobel Prize).
shorts_extract.twist: Why widening the arena to 2 meters revealed the honeycomb, how humans map abstract ideas on 60° grids, and early Alzheimer's entorhinal clues.
